en: Dependent on a state that is to be abandoned by vision, a state that is not to be abandoned by vision arises by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state that is to be abandoned by vision, a state that is not to be abandoned by cultivation arises by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state to be abandoned by seeing, there arises a state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by cultivation, by way of the root condition.

Dependent on a state to be abandoned by seeing, there arise states to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by cultivation, and states to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by cultivation, by way of the root condition. Dependent on a state to be abandoned by seeing... [and so forth].
Dependent on a state to be abandoned by seeing, states that are both not to be abandoned by seeing and not to be abandoned by cultivation arise by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state to be abandoned by cultivation, a state that is not to be abandoned by cultivation arises by way of the root condition … [five].
Dependent on a state not to be abandoned by vision and not to be abandoned by cultivation, a state not to be abandoned by vision arises by way of root condition … three.

Dependent on a state to be abandoned by vision and a state not to be abandoned by vision and not to be abandoned by cultivation, a state not to be abandoned by vision arises by way of root condition … three.

Dependent on a state to be abandoned by cultivation and a state not to be abandoned by vision and not to be abandoned by cultivation, a state not to be abandoned by vision arises by way of root condition … three. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of the root condition, there are nineteen; in the object condition, nine ... pe ... in the result condition, three ... pe ...
in the non-disappearance condition, nineteen. (The "Conascent" section, the "Associated" section, and the "Investigation" section should also be expanded in detail.)
